notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start (8)': the Objective (posted 'You Can Either Profit By This....'), Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol (posted 'EPP Han', the Han the Objective places in the Audience Chamber), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Wise Advice, Twilight Is Upon Me and Insurrection; these count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty. With the second 'Han with Heavy Blaster Pistol' in Characters the deck has 2 copies of that card.

The listed cards total 59; the author's note says 'i'm 1 card short, that card should be SomeOne Who Loves You', so Someone Who Loves You is added (total 60). His other note ('Swap It's a Trap for Mantellian Savrip') is not applied; dested as posted. Section header counts (Locations 7, Characters 13, Interrupts 23) disagree with the list; the author corrects Characters to 14 and Interrupts to 20.

Posted 'Massa Luke' dested Master Luke; 'Boussh x2' Boushh (2 copies of a unique card, as posted); 'Orimaarko' Orrimaarko; 'Lando in Millenium Falcon' Lando In Millennium Falcon; 'WYTTPOU' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'It's a Trap' It's A Trap!; 'Spaceport Docking Bay' the Special Edition generic site; Weapon Levitation, Sense and Alter are the Light cards.
Wise Advice, Do, Or Do Not and the other Effects are the pre-Reflections III Effects (no Defensive Shields existed in September 2000).
